senses.gloss: m.(b. h. לֹעַ; לעע or לוע, cmp. לוֹג, a. לוֹחָא)jaw.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 81">Gen. R. s. 81</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:32">Yalk. Prov. 959</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="J00396"><he>יָלַע</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 20:25">Prov. XX, 25</cite>) <he>אוכל קדשים בלוֹעוֹ</he> who chews sacred things with his jaw.

<cite ref="Proverbs 20:25">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 58b:18">Snh. 58ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>הסוטר לוֹעוֹ וכ׳</he> he who strikes an Israelite’s jaw, is regarded as if striking the Shekhinah.
